propositions: A packaged prose guide cites criterion IDs inline (e.g., G6, F1, E2) but has no mechanism to detect when a cited criterion's registry text changes, allowing semantic drift to ship silently.

The existing validate_criteria_guide() only checks the generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md and test_guides.py only couples guides to coach_moves.MOVE_REGISTRY, leaving 19 of 20 cited criteria in the plan guide uncoupled from the registry.

A citation-pin manifest derived from the registry's current criterion texts provides a systematic gate: when criterion text changes, the pin diverges and fails the gate, forcing re-verification of the guide's claim before re-pinning.
The pin gate must extract citations vocabulary-only (matching CANONICAL_LLM at word boundaries, no markup dependence) so ordinary prose edits do not trigger false gate failures.
